title: Claude Bootstrap Security Policy
description: Project-level security policy used by claude-bootstrap hardening tools and command guards.

$schema.description: Optional editor annotation pointing at this schema. Allowed so an IDE-completed policy still validates.

version.description: Versioned policy format. Version 1 is the initial baseline policy format.

managedBy.description: Identifier for the tool that created the default policy.

profile.description: Hardening profile that supplied this policy.

protectedBranches.description: Branches that should receive stricter Git protections.

production.description: Signals used to identify production-like environments.

markers.description: Text markers that indicate production context.

kubeContexts.description: Kubernetes contexts that should be treated as production.

terraformWorkspaces.description: Terraform workspaces that should be treated as production.

awsAccountIds.description: Deprecated and ignored: no guard rule reads the AWS account. Kept so existing policies still validate; remove it from yours.

paths.description: Path policy hints for command guard decisions.

safeRecursiveDelete.description: Project paths whose recursive deletion needs no confirmation, such as build output. Matched project-relative or by bare directory name; replaces the built-in list when set.

generated.description: Glob patterns for generated or vendored files.

secrets.description: Secret detection policy for Write and Edit guards.

allowPaths.description: Glob patterns for files whose secret findings are reported as a warning instead of blocking, for example test fixtures and documentation samples.

largeFiles.description: Thresholds for large file warnings and confirmation prompts.

warningLines.description: Line count where large file warnings begin.

askOnCreateLines.description: Line count where creating a new file requires confirmation.

askOnGrowthLines.description: Line growth count where editing a file requires confirmation.

commandGuard.description: Optional command guard behavior overrides for stricter profiles.

parserUncertainty.description: Deprecated and ignored: unsupported shell parser constructs always require confirmation. Kept so existing policies still validate; remove it from yours.

unknownEnvironment.description: How production-sensitive operations behave when environment context is unknown.

terraformWorkspaceCommand.description: Allow the guard to run `terraform workspace show` when .terraform/environment is missing. Off by default: the command can reach a remote backend from inside a hook.

infrastructureChecks.description: Deprecated and ignored: the infrastructure families a guard reviews are not configurable. Kept so existing policies still validate; remove it from yours.

database.description: Database command guard behavior for destructive operations.

destructiveOperations.description: Decision level for high-confidence destructive database operations.

decision.description: Decision values returned by hardening guard rules.
